domain_name.description: The default domain name appended to unqualified hostnames in DHCP replies.

name_servers.description: List of DNS resolver IP addresses to assign to DHCP clients.

default_lease_time.description: Default duration (in seconds) a client's IP address lease lasts if not explicitly requested.

max_lease_time.description: Maximum duration (in seconds) a client may hold a lease.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for DHCP logs (e.g., local0–local7).

ddns_update_style.description: Enable dynamic DNS updates. 'none' disables updates.

ddns_domain_name.description: Zone domain name used for DDNS updates (e.g., 'example.com').

ddns_primary_server.description: Primary DNS server to send DDNS updates to.

ddns_key_name.description: Name of the TSIG key used to authenticate DDNS updates.

netmask.description: Netmask for the subnet (e.g., 255.255.255.0). Auto-derived if omitted.

start.description: First IP in the dynamic pool.

end.description: Last IP in the dynamic pool.

gateway.description: Default gateway/router IP to assign to clients.

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP server IPs for time sync.

wpad_url.description: URL of the Web Proxy Auto-Discovery (WPAD) file.

hosts.description: Static host reservations. Each entry maps a MAC to a fixed IP and optional hostname.

hostname.description: Optional hostname to assign (must be DNS-valid).
